title: Début jouable — appartement puis Marine
purpose: Valider le rythme jeu/cinématique/choix avant de produire la bibliothèque complète.

structure.effect: La tenue choisie devient une contrainte de continuité pour toutes les scènes suivantes jusqu'au prochain changement.

structure.note: Pas de téléportation narrative vers Dominic.

structure.effect: Les réponses alimentent état relationnel, sujets connus et variantes futures.

content: continuer la journée selon l'état du monde
structure.note: Dominic n'est pas déclenché automatiquement dans ce vertical slice.

variable: timing et conditions des rencontres futures

existingGameplayIntegration.rule: Do not replace existing Day 1 simulation with a linear cinematic. Generated media enriches existing states and transitions.
existingGameplayIntegration.firstContactVariation: Preserve seeded encounter windows and contexts already implemented; Dominic arrival must remain unknown to the player.
existingGameplayIntegration.marineConversation: Preserve topic pool, response choices, elapsed-time effects and before/after-contact phases.

displayTargets.cinematicRule: Generate landscape master media with face/action safe zones so responsive layouts can contain or crop without losing identity-critical content.
displayTargets.phoneMediaRule: Vertical media is allowed only as in-world phone/visio/photo content, not as the master game format.

steps: Keep opening directly playable; do not force a long intro movie.
Replace placeholder apartment presentation progressively with canonical visual assets.
Make wardrobe a real choice whose selected outfit persists into generated scenes.
Use Marine message and existing free-morning logic as the first branching pressure, not a forced quest.
Attach generated clips only where they add embodiment: dressing transition, leaving home, meeting/reaction beats, major cinematic moments.
